name: Send personalized corporate gift offers enriched with Apollo after approving each email
description: For each target company, enriches the company and contact in Apollo and drafts a personalized holiday gift offer. Every email waits for the author's approval before it is sent.
shortDescription: Enrich target companies in Apollo, draft a gift offer for each and send it once you approve it.
keyFeatures: AI B2B sales agent with Apollo company and person enrichment tools
Personalized holiday gift offer for each company
Approval gate: every email waits for the author's approval before it is sent
prerequisites: Google Sheets and Google Mail (Gmail) connections
A spreadsheet of target companies; replace REPLACE_WITH_B2B_TARGETS_SPREADSHEET_ID
Replace REPLACE_WITH_AUTHOR_EMAIL with the address that approves the emails
idealFor: Authors and small brands selling their product as a corporate gift.
steps: Read the target companies from Google Sheets.
The B2B sales agent enriches each company and contact in Apollo and drafts a gift offer.
Each offer email waits for the author's approval, then is sent from Gmail.
